name: qatlas-dev
description: Code pack for qatlas: a lazy senior developer who makes the smallest change that fully solves the task, plus a quality review of a change and an audit of a whole repo.

interface.shortDescription: The smallest change that fully works
interface.longDescription: Code pack for Qatlas. A lazy senior developer in three levels (lite, full, ultra) who asks whether something needs to exist at all, uses the codebase, the standard library and the platform before new code, and leaves one small check behind. A review skill checks a change and an audit skill a whole repo for bugs, risk, scale, missing tests, speed and bloat, each finding in plain English. Requires qatlas.
defaultPrompt: Build this the laziest way that works.
